### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-email`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **68** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **6** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/templates/auth-templates.ts`, `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`, `packages/spec/liveness/email_template.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**28** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3f694715ee43565502bd70d6b3a64b28033531b4`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **6** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/templates/auth-templates.ts`, `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`, `packages/spec/liveness/email_template.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **13** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **140** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3f694715ee43565502bd70d6b3a64b28033531b4` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c3748bd364a84916c236129fc4fbd8a3b9c52303` — the merge of head `78c3eed6389de37493b25586bfb6c48f02c63188` into base `3f694715ee43565502bd70d6b3a64b28033531b4`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c3748bd364a84916c236129fc4fbd8a3b9c52303 && git checkout c3748bd364a84916c236129fc4fbd8a3b9c52303
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 3f694715ee43565502bd70d6b3a64b28033531b4 78c3eed6389de37493b25586bfb6c48f02c63188 && git checkout -B drift-repro 3f694715ee43565502bd70d6b3a64b28033531b4 && git merge --no-ff 78c3eed6389de37493b25586bfb6c48f02c63188

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3f694715ee43565502bd70d6b3a64b28033531b4
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 3f694715ee43565502bd70d6b3a64b28033531b4` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4aa656e7a2f67d213e01a885960d281937483c03`
Local-runs: none

Rendered by an isolated reviewer subagent of the seat in `Reviewed-by`, which adopts it.

Inputs, read at 2026-10-11T21:18Z: card #15205 (body and all 21 comments; the seat's ACCEPT `6112901622` and its Q1 answer `6111829211` read as data), ruling record `6020178017` on #22005, triage routing `6108741731`, PR #22875 (body, 49-file list, net diff against `main` at the merge base `0253192f7`), and the head's check-runs: 46 runs, 39 success, 7 skipped, 0 failed; latest run per name 31 success and 4 skipped (Auto Label, Check PR Size, Console Pin Gate, Packed-tarball smoke), none in progress. Every gate verdict is green.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`@objectstack/plugin-email` public face narrows — right.** `src/index.ts` drops `createSysEmailTemplateLoader`, `TemplateLoaderEngine`, `CreateTemplateLoaderOptions`, `bootstrapDeclaredEmailTemplates`, `upsertDeclaredEmailTemplate`, `deactivateDeclaredEmailTemplate`, `mapTemplateToRow`, `EMAIL_TEMPLATE_OBJECT`, `BootstrapDeclaredEmailTemplatesResult`; `EmailServicePluginOptions` loses `seedTemplates` and `templates`. Each is named in the changeset with its FROM → TO line. `git grep` at the head finds no remaining consumer outside tests, CHANGELOGs and comments.
2. **`@objectstack/plugin-email` public face also WIDENS — right as code, wrong as declared.** `src/index.ts` adds `createRegistryEmailTemplateLoader` and the type `EmailTemplateRegistrySources`, both reachable from the package's single `exports` entry. Under the claim rule (公开面 = 包构建后的入口声明所达;所达 = 再导出名,加经其 props、参数与返回类型可达的每个类型) two new reachable declarations enlarge the public face. The claim's reason for `no` — "no published type widens" — is false: `EmailTemplateRegistrySources` is a new published type. The board's recent declarations read a new published member the same way (#22767 and #22779 `yes (widening)`; #22863 `yes (narrowing)` for a replace). The accurate line is `yes (narrowing)`; the level it owes (at least `minor`) is already met. See ②.
3. **`BUILTIN_EMAIL_TEMPLATES_PACKAGE_ID` — right.** Exported by `template-loader.ts` but not by the entry, and the `exports` map has `.` only, so it is not public.
4. **Resolution behaviour against ruling C, D6 and D10 — right.** `createRegistryEmailTemplateLoader` reads `email_template` at every load from `protocol.getMetaItemsForExecution` (the environment's item over each package's declaration; no default page limit was found on that read) or from the ObjectQL registry when no protocol is registered; the read names no organization (option A of §6 Q1 stays rejected); within one `(name, locale)` slot any item not under `com.objectstack.service.email` wins over the built-in; a failed read propagates; a malformed item refuses the send with the schema's message. The locale ladder is unchanged. The built-ins are code-declared through the plugin manifest's `emailTemplates` key, which `registerApp` consumes. All 24 built-ins are pinned byte-identical to the seeded-row render (subject in clear, html and text by SHA-256).
5. **Retirement list against the ruling — right.** `seedTemplates`, the boot sweep (`bootstrapEffectiveEmailTemplates` / `EffectiveEmailTemplateSources`, the two names the ruling added), the live projector and the row loader are gone. The plugin neither reads nor writes `sys_email_template`; the stage-1 organization door stays bound and closed; no row is promoted or deleted (C7, #15211); the table is not retired (D13). The ADR dated note is not in this diff and already sits on `main` (§6 Q1, "Ruled 2026-10-06: C"), as stage 1 carried it.
6. **Wire shape — right.** `PUT /api/v1/meta/email_template/:name` no longer carries `projectionApplied`, an optional receipt key; the changeset says so.
7. **`packages/spec` published face — right, with one evidence defect.** Describe and TSDoc text, plus two refusal messages, in `automation/io-node-config.zod.ts`, `contracts/email-service.ts`, `system/email-template.zod.ts` and `system/notification.zod.ts`; no shape change. The liveness ledger re-anchors every live row to `template-loader.ts#toRenderInput` / `#createRegistryEmailTemplateLoader` and the service's reads, and re-grades `category` and `isSystem` `dead` (their only reader was the retired row projection — an honest measurement). **Defect:** the ledger's cross-repo evidence for `label` and `description`, and the dead notes for `category` and `isSystem`, are stated "at the `.objectui-sha` pin 0df67f23", but `.objectui-sha` at both the merge base and this head is `4997995022f8`. A hand-written measurement cited at a superseded pin is unverifiable against this tree.
8. **`@objectstack/service-automation` — right** (the notify node's `template` help text names the email templates). **`@objectstack/platform-objects` — right** (header and provenance comments only; no field help, no published text).
9. **Lint behaviour — right, carried.** Through the ledger, `@objectstack/lint` now draws one `liveness-dead-property` advisory for `category` and for a truthy `isSystem`; the two `packages/lint` cases pin rule id and property path, not wording. The built-ins themselves (`category: 'auth'`, `isSystem: true`) trip it; #22876 retires both keys.
10. **Gate-forced edits — right.** Shrink-only baseline rows, the `isystem-census` row for the deleted module, the re-pointed swallow-family control, regenerated censuses and reference pages; the showcase test and the three dogfood files are re-pinned against the loader, not deleted.

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/plugin-email: minor` with the **BREAKING** banner — right: `main` is in pre mode (`next`) and `check-changeset-no-major` forbids `major` in the launch window. `@objectstack/spec: patch` and `@objectstack/service-automation: patch` — right (text and a measurement ledger; no shape). No row for `platform-objects`, `lint`, `dogfood` or the showcase — right (comments and tests only).
- **`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` — the arm is right, the value is wrong.** The diff narrows AND widens the published face of `@objectstack/plugin-email` (① 1 and 2). The one legal spelling for that is `yes (narrowing)` — a diff that widens one surface and narrows another, both facts read. All three carriers read `no`: PR body line 2, `.changeset/15205-email-templates-resolve-registry.md`, and the claim `6109130514` as amended by `6112650531`. Both changeset gates stay green either way; what is wrong is the declaration, which is one of the three faces this review exists to check.
- **ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` — substance right, category wrong by the ADR's letter; escalated, not charged to the dev.** Nothing moves for `objectstack migrate meta` (no spec key, stored shape or row), so no ledger entry is the right answer. But the body carries a FROM → TO block (six lines under "What moves for consumers"), and ADR-0087's 2026-08-13 addendum reads this category as refused by a body that carries a migration prescription; the gate admits it only because the lines carry no arrow, which its detector requires. No admissible category exists for this shape: `runtime-interface-only` names interfaces or types that still exist at HEAD and inherits the same refusal; `type-surface-only` fails predicate 2 because the diff touches `packages/spec`. Stage 1's changeset (`15205-email-template-org-door-closed.md`, maintainer-approved) holds the same category for the same class. The gap in the vocabulary, not this PR, is the finding — see ③.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Q1 (`category` / `isSystem` graded dead) — answered B by the seat; judged right.** NORTH-STAR's batch-retirement posture applies, the ledger stays honest, the advisory is non-blocking, and #22876 (open, `Blocked-by: #15205`) carries the retirement together with the objectui editor change and the pin bump.
- **A second-locale Studio save replaces the first locale's overlay at rest — answered.** Pre-existing; filed as #22877 (open).
- **`EmailServicePlugin.destroy()` leaves the `sys_email` outbox drain hook bound after shutdown — NOT answered.** The dev reported it twice ("the seat may add it to Acceptance notes"); it is in neither the PR body nor any card. Pre-existing and not this PR's, but an out-of-scope finding with no carrier: the seat files it or names its carrier in the Acceptance notes.
- **Comment-only references to retired names** (`objectql/src/registry.ts`, two tests, `spec/scripts/liveness/proof-registry.mts` class prose, the dogfood fixture header) — accepted as comment-only; `proof-registry.mts` still says a template is materialized into a `sys_email_template` row, a sentence #22876's batch can take.
- **Transitional cost** — a row an organization customized no longer sends until C7 promotes it. Sanctioned by ruling C's sequencing (C4, then the ceremony at the v18 upgrade) and disclosed in the changeset with the interim fix; it holds only if #15211 lands on the `next` line before v18 GA.
- **Premise re-measured at claim** (unlock `6107783347`) — done at `d8c7d3864`: a Studio save lands environment-scoped and is read live and after a cold boot. The card's "`metadata.subscribe` path" named the wrong mechanism; the acceptance's outcome (live, no restart) is pinned through the registry write-through. Accepted.
- **Cross-lane paths** (`packages/spec`, dogfood, platform-objects, lint, docs) — declared under the exception path per triage `6108741731` and the seat's claim amendments. Accepted.
- **`check:platform-checklist` 8 findings** — identical on `origin/main` `69d421805`, not this PR's; the seat confirms a card exists for that main-side red or files one.
- **No ADR anchor** in `scripts/adr-anchors/` names the loader's no-organization registry read, the load-bearing spot of D6 and D10; the ADR ids are in the code. Optional, not blocking.
- **Escalation to the maintainer**, who approves this landing in any case (4,575 changed lines: the Tier H human terminal; this record does not substitute that approval): the ADR-0087 disposition vocabulary has no verifiable category for a compiler-carried removal of runtime exports in a diff that also touches `packages/spec`, and this changeset and stage 1's both hold the catch-all on a detector miss. Either the reading "no metadata migration prescription" is ruled for this class and written into the ADR's addendum, or a seventh category is added. Until then the marker's `why` should state the FROM → TO block and the gap in one sentence instead of relying on the gate's silence.

**What clears this FAIL — one commit plus two text edits:** (1) `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` on the changeset line, on PR body line 2 and in a claim amendment; (2) the liveness ledger's cross-repo evidence re-measured, or restated, at the tree's pin `4997995022f8`; (3) a carrier for the drain-hook finding; (4) the ADR-0087 marker's `why` naming the FROM → TO block and the vocabulary gap it sits in, for the maintainer's ruling.

Reviewed-by: `session_013LbZ9MhPp1iriZEtgJqioA`

**VERDICT: FAIL**
